fire: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent production 2D weapon sprite for Denti, a warm colorful cartoon dental arena game. Edit input image 1, the existing Zauberbürste, into ONE elemental form. Retain its unmistakable long slender magic TOOTHBRUSH identity, tooth medallion, warm gold jewelry, vertical upright orientation, same painterly glossy volume, crisp dark warm outlines, friendly dental fantasy tone, and full uncut silhouette. Keep shaft and bottom grip centered exactly as in the reference, grip near normalized canvas (0.5,0.93), brush head near (0.52,0.1), tip position and overall aspect/composition unchanged. True transparent RGBA background, remove all original background glow and haze. The design must read as a toothbrush at only 70px tall. Chunky distinctive head silhouette and materials; not merely a recolor. Keep visible bristle groups. One centered upright brush only, plenty of transparent padding, no text, no frame, no floor shadow, no scattered effects, no floating particles or broad glow. FIRE: bristle tufts become short thick flame-shaped orange amber bristles with dark red bases and glowing golden tips. The brush backing is flame-forged red enamel with two chunky upward-curving flame fins around the head. Gold trim and ivory tooth emblem remain. Replace green vines with a restrained sculpted red-and-gold flame ribbon winding the shaft. Solid compact flame shapes belong to the weapon, no streaming fire plume.
